provenance.interpretation: Actual frozen computed results, not observed journeys. Teaching hypotheses explicitly separated.

data_quality.request_count_semantics: one initial query per unique origin for one frozen scenario; retries extra

rail_operation_review.exclusion_reason: LTA ties opening to surrounding developments; opening date not advised
rail_operation_review.matching_rule: exact station name after uppercase and whitespace normalisation
scope_notes: Marina South Pier is a different station and is retained
Mount Pleasant is also not yet open per LTA, but has no exit in this source
CC30, CC31 and CC32 opened on 2026-07-12; retain their delivered exits
Other retained exits, including LRT exits, are not individually certified operational
Temporary entrance closures and full bus-stop operation are not covered by this review

readiness_blockers: 107 postal conflicts require adjudication; held-out records excluded
Residential use is source-classification evidence only; independent use review outstanding
Identified unopened station excluded; remaining rail exits and bus stops still need operation review
Non-reserve park/corridor categories and public opening require review; distances provisional
Facility address precision, licence grouping and coordinate spread need sample review
Destination review, public-transit coverage and independent route evidence are tracked separately from static preparation
data_quality.facility_units: complete postal+street+floor+unit groups; incomplete addresses retained by licence
data_quality.coordinate_semantics: B coordinates retained; A coordinate differences audited, never overwritten

measurement_labels.rail_exit_euclid_m: Euclidean proximity after identified-closed exclusion; remaining operation not fully verified
measurement_labels.bus_stops_800m: Euclidean stop-point count, not routes/frequency, operation unverified
measurement_labels.park_proximity_euclid_m: polygon proximity; inside zero; not entrance/network access

spatial_comparison.interpretation: Different unit sizes change footprint overlap; this alone is not robustness evidence.
spatial_comparison.building_count_semantics: Distinct candidate source records, not verified households or capacity
spatial_comparison.extent_semantics: Projected bounding-box diagonal, not exact diameter or estate boundary

teaching_hypotheses.label: Invented two-indicator arithmetic example; not a real residence or a pipeline output

original_delivery_checks.interpretation: Original five demo routes are separate from the production snapshot; this is not an island-wide result.
